learning_outcomes.text: Application of sources and detectors and fiber optics in examples.

syllabus_topics: Planck law, Wien law, Boltzman law.
Radiation sources. Thermal sources and its properties.
Plasma, and luminescence sources and its properties.
External photoelectric effect detectors (vacuum diode, photomultiplier).
Internal photoelectric effect detectors (photoresistor, photodiode, phototransistor).
Design and calculation of optoelectronic devices.
bibliography: Bukshtab, Michael, Applied Photometry, Radiometry, and Measurements of Optical Losses, Springer Netherlands, 2012.
Emmanuel Rosencher, Borge Vinter, Optoelectronics, Cambridge University Press, 2002
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
